title: Penne & Ground Beef
author: farag4m

step.title: Saute onions
step.text: Using Saute mode, heat 1 tbsp olive oil and cook the diced onion for 3–4 minutes until soft.

step.title: Brown and season beef
step.text: Add the ground beef, break it apart, and cook for 4–5 minutes until lightly browned. Add salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and optional onion powder and red pepper flakes. Saute for another minute.

step.title: Add penne
step.text: Pour in 4 cups water and scrape the bottom of the pot well. Add the dry penne and gently press it down so it touches the liquid. Do not stir heavily.

step.title: Add pesto
step.text: Add the pesto to the cooked pasta and beef. Stir well until everything is evenly coated.

step.title: Pressure cook
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes, then immediately quick release.

step.title: Finish
step.text: Stir in the pesto until the pasta and beef are fully coated. If desired, add Parmesan and a small splash of cream. Serve warm.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. Keep the pasta mostly on top of the beef before pressure cooking and avoid heavily stirring it into the liquid.
